verdict.rationale: Mesh returns screening outcomes in machine-readable form: a `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED` webhook payload with a `customer-screening.step_output.screening_result` field shows whether hits were found, and synchronous screening suits real-time onboarding. A configurable risk score and API access to cases, alerts and risks give an automated flow signals to branch on, all described by a published OpenAPI schema. Missing for 10: documented structured failure or reason codes, field-level detail on the risk-signal payloads, and independent hands-on confirmation of agent-driven branching.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, verification outcomes come back structured enough for an agent to decide on — machine-readable check results, risk signals, and failure reasons an automated onboarding flow can branch on

citations.quote: Refer to the `customer-screening.step_output.screening_result` field in the webhook payload to determine if any hits were found
Synchronous screening: Ideal for real-time onboarding workflows where low latency is critical.
You have the ability to configure the equation that calculates the risk score of your customers.
Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
